In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
none of the evaluated approaches is superior to the others in all aspects and the best performing approach is highly dependent on the specific task.
the most promising approach is DeepLIFT.
the most suitable saliency map for Deep Reinforcement learning is the Gradient * Input approach.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the gradient based approaches are faster, more faithful to the agent's behavior and more stable than the other approaches.
the gradient-based saliency map (DeepLIFT) performs best for most of the considered games and metrics, followed by the Integrated Gradients (IG).
the saliency map of the DeepLIFT algorithm is the best choice for Deep Reinforcement agents.
The main takeaway from our work is that
all four saliency map algorithms have their advantages and disadvantages.
the saliency map of the agent trained on the game Freeway shows a very different pattern compared to the other three agents.
the choice of perturbation method has a large impact on the quality of the saliency map.
